name: Traversal iterators close on every loop exit path

input.fixture_ref: A custom Iterator records close() during natural, break, exception, and return exits.

applicability.reason: Requires for-in traversal over a programmable Iterator. `for x in It.new()` answers MessageNotFoundError, so no traversal exit path exists to observe close() on.

expect.status: close() is invoked on every traversal exit path before the pending transfer commits.
